# Commercialization Code Audit — `D:\1code\cursor\downAiGC`

Below is a file-by-file map of what exists today vs. what your PM doc requires.

---

## 1. Pricing Constants

### Backend — `D:\1code\cursor\downAiGC\backend\pricing.py`

| Constant / Function | Lines | Current Value |
|---|---|---|
| `BENCHMARK_WORDS` | 11 | `7166` |
| `BENCHMARK_YUAN` | 12 | `0.07` |
| `YUAN_PER_WORD` | 14 | `≈0.0000105` |
| `ad_watch_reward_points()` | 17–18 | **450** (env `AD_WATCH_REWARD_POINTS`, default `"450"`) |
| `points_per_yuan()` | 21–23 | **1200** (env `POINTS_PER_YUAN`, default `"1200"`) |
| `MEMBER_PLAN_WORD_QUOTAS` | 27–34 | d1=6k, w7=45k, m30=180k, q90=480k, h180=880k, y365=1.75M |
| `MEMBER_PLAN_RETAIL_YUAN` | 36–43 | d1=5.99, w7=39.9, m30=149.9, q90=399.9, h180=729.9, y365=1459.9 |

Env overrides documented in `backend\.env.example` lines 95–97.

### Frontend — `D:\1code\cursor\downAiGC\frontend\src\config\pricing.ts`

| Constant | Lines | Current Value |
|---|---|---|
| `AD_WATCH_REWARD_POINTS` | 11 | **450** (hardcoded, not env) |
| `POINTS_PER_YUAN` | 14 | **1200** |
| `MEMBER_PLAN_WORD_QUOTAS` | 17–24 | Same 6 tiers as backend |
| `MEMBER_PLAN_RETAIL_YUAN` | 26–33 | Same prices as backend |
| `memberWordsRemaining()` | 35–37 | `max(0, quota - used)` |
| `PROFIT_PLAYBOOK_SUMMARY` | 44–45 | References 450 ad / m30 word quota model |

**PM doc changes needed:** Update both files to **3000 points/yuan**, **1000 ad reward**, replace 6-tier word-quota plans with **39元/100k** and **99元/500k** monthly gift-point plans; recharge packages **9.9 / 19.9 / 39.9 / 99**.

---

## 2. Points / Balance Storage

### Models — `D:\1code\cursor\downAiGC\backend\models\entities.py`

| Model | Lines | Fields |
|---|---|---|
| `User` | 17–35 | `balance_cents` (line 27) — yuan balance in cents |
| `PointState` | 38–46 | `points`, `last_signin_date`, `streak` |
| `UserQuota` | 65–71 | `words_quota` default **120000** — admin/segmentation only, **not used in billing** |
| `AdWatchTicket` | 49–62 | One-time ad reward tickets |

### Repos

| File | Key Functions |
|---|---|
| `backend\repositories\auth_repo.py` | `create_user()` L22–35: creates `PointState(points=0)` + `UserQuota(words_quota=default_quota)` |
| `backend\repositories\ad_watch_repo.py` | `complete_ticket_and_credit_points()` L52–90: credits `PointState.points` |
| `backend\repositories\redeem_repo.py` | `try_redeem()` L146–155: credits points or `balance_cents` |

### API Endpoints — `D:\1code\cursor\downAiGC\backend\main.py`

| Endpoint | Lines | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/points/me` | 3474–3488 | Returns `{ points, balanceYuan, signIn }` |
| `POST /api/points/signin` | 3437–3471 | Streak sign-in reward via `compute_signin_reward()` |
| `POST /api/redeem/use` | 3420–3434 | Redeem codes → points/balance |
| `POST /api/ad/watch-tickets` | 3491–3511 | Create ad ticket (reward from `_ad_watch_reward_points()`) |
| `GET /api/ad/watch-tickets/{id}` | 3514–3529 | Poll ticket status |
| `POST /api/ad/watch/complete` | 3553–3563 | Complete ticket → credit points |
| `POST /api/tasks` | 3566–3605 | **No point deduction** — only creates task |

### Frontend state — `D:\1code\cursor\downAiGC\frontend\src\state\RewardContext.tsx`

- Bootstrap L35–64: loads server `points` + `balanceYuan` from `/api/points/me`, merges with localStorage.
- `addPoints()` L95–97: **local only** — does **not** POST to backend.
- `addBalanceYuan()` L99–104: **local only**.

**Critical gap:** Task deductions via `addPoints(-N)` are client-side only and lost on refresh when server points overwrite local state.

**PM doc changes:** Add server-side ledger (deduct/credit APIs), registration grant **5000**, daily free pool **1000/day cap 3000**, persist all billing server-side.

---

## 3. Membership System

### `D:\1code\cursor\downAiGC\frontend\src\state\MembershipContext.tsx`

- **Entirely client-side** (`localStorage` key `downaigc_membership_vip`, L4).
- `VipTierSelection`: `planKey`, `wordsQuota`, `wordsUsed`, `activatedAt` (L6–13).
- `setVipTier()` L82–94: sets quota from `MEMBER_PLAN_WORD_QUOTAS`.
- `consumeMemberWords()` L97–108: decrements local `wordsUsed`.
- **No backend membership table or API.**

### `D:\1code\cursor\downAiGC\frontend\src\pages\DashboardPage.tsx`

- `MEMBER_PLANS` L27–102: 8 plans (d1 through life) with prices from hardcoded `total`, not `MEMBER_PLAN_RETAIL_YUAN`.
- `onActivatePlan()` L109–127: calls `setVipTier()` — **demo activation**, no payment.
- Copy L145: "周期内改写字数额度（优先消耗）；额度用尽后按积分计费".

### Backend admin approximation — `backend\repositories\admin_repo.py`

- `_DEFAULT_FREE_WORDS_QUOTA = 120_000` L12.
- `_user_segment()` L15–30: VIP tiers inferred from `UserQuota.words_quota` thresholds — **not connected to frontend membership**.

**PM doc changes:** **Remove** word-quota membership model (`MembershipContext`, `taskBilling` quota path, `DashboardPage` 6-tier plans). Replace with **2 monthly plans** that grant **100k / 500k points** on subscribe/renew (server-side).

---

## 4. Ad Watch Rewards

### Backend ticket flow — `backend\main.py` + `ad_watch_repo.py`

- Reward: `_ad_watch_reward_points()` → **450** (L1315–1316, L3499).
- TTL: `_ad_watch_ttl_seconds()` default **900s** (L1333–1334).
- **No daily limit** per user — unlimited tickets.

### Frontend

| File | Lines | Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| `frontend\src\components\AdCarousel.tsx` | 19–25 | `WATCH_AD_REWARD_POINTS = AD_WATCH_REWARD_POINTS` (450) |
| `frontend\src\pages\WalletPointsPage.tsx` | 189–198 | Opens `AdWatchQrModal` for "领积分" |
| `frontend\src\components\AdWatchQrModal.tsx` | 11–103 | Uses **AdHub** QR (`adhubWatchUrl`), **not** `/api/ad/watch-tickets` |
| `frontend\src\components\AdPlayerModal.tsx` | 17–49 | Local demo: `addPoints(reward)` after 30s — no server |

**PM doc changes:** Reward **1000**; enforce **5/day normal, 10/day member, unlimited premium** (needs new DB counter + midnight reset); wire AdHub completion to server credit; align frontend constant with backend.

---

## 5. Registration Flow & Initial Points

| Path | File | Lines | Current Behavior |
|---|---|---|---|
| Email/password | `RegisterPage.tsx` | 60–67 | `POST /api/auth/register` |
| Email + code | `AuthMethodModal.tsx` | ~409 | `POST /api/auth/email/register` |
| Backend register | `main.py` | 2970–2984 | `auth_repo.create_user(..., default_quota=DEFAULT_WORD_QUOTA)` |
| Backend email register | `main.py` | 3123–3129 | Same |
| `create_user()` | `auth_repo.py` | 31–32 | **`PointState(points=0)`**, `UserQuota(120000)` |

`DEFAULT_WORD_QUOTA = 120000` at `main.py` L1535.

**PM doc changes:** Grant **5000 points** on register in `create_user()` (and migration for existing users if needed). Remove or repurpose `UserQuota` 120k default.

---

## 6. Daily Free Quota

**Does not exist** in current code.

Closest alternatives:

| Feature | Location | Current Logic |
|---|---|---|
| Sign-in streak | `compute_signin_reward()` `main.py` L1132–1134 | **10 + (streak-1)×2**, cap **30**/day |
| Frontend mirror | `rewardState.ts` L82–84 | Same formula |
| `POST /api/points/signin` | `main.py` L3437–3471 | Once per calendar day (UTC date via `_iso_date_utc`) |

No "1000 free daily", no "3000 cap", no midnight refresh pool.

**PM doc changes:** New entity (e.g. `daily_free_pool` / `free_points_balance`) + cron/midnight reset + consume-before-paid-points logic in billing.

---

## 7. Task Billing

### `D:\1code\cursor\downAiGC\frontend\src\utils\taskBilling.ts`

```1:21:D:\1code\cursor\downAiGC\frontend\src\utils\taskBilling.ts
/** 任务扣费：优先消耗会员字数额度，不足部分按积分（1 字 ≈ 1 积分） */
export function resolveTaskCharge(
  wordCost: number,
  memberWordsRemaining: number,
  points: number
): { ok: boolean; quotaDue: number; pointsDue: number; message?: string } {
  // ...
  const quotaDue = Math.min(wordCost, Math.max(0, memberWordsRemaining));
  const pointsDue = wordCost - quotaDue;
```

### `GooeySplitButton.tsx` — `chargeForTask()` L90–102

1. `countBackendWords(rawText.trim())` → cost (L128, L174).
2. `resolveTaskCharge()` → member quota first, then points.
3. `consumeMemberWords(quotaDue)` + `addPoints(-pointsDue)` (L97–98).
4. Then `POST /api/tasks` — **no cost sent to backend**.

### `UploadCard.tsx` — L47–55, L219–235

- Shows `taskCharge.pointsDue` as "预计消耗 … **积分**".
- Shows member quota deduction if `vip`.

**PM doc changes:**

- Deduct on **output** (polished text), not input — move charge from `GooeySplitButton` task-create to paragraph completion (`PolishWorkbenchPage` `finishTypingAnimation` L409–416 or backend `process_paragraph`).
- Remove `quotaDue` / member word path from `resolveTaskCharge`.
- Add server-side deduct API; order: daily free → points.
- Rename UI to **"剩余可改写字数"**.

---

## 8. Recharge Page

### `D:\1code\cursor\downAiGC\frontend\src\pages\WalletRechargePage.tsx`

| Lines | Current |
|---|---|
| 7–10 | Local demo via `addBalanceYuan()` |
| 46–48 | Preset tiers: **¥9.90, ¥49.90, ¥99.00** |
| 23 | "余额仅保存在本机浏览器" |

No conversion balance → points. No packages at 19.9/39.9. No `POINTS_PER_YUAN` usage.

### `WalletPointsPage.tsx` L177–179

Demo buttons: `addPoints(POINTS_PER_YUAN)`, `×3`, `×10` — local only.

**PM doc changes:** Tiers **9.9 / 19.9 / 39.9 / 99** at **3000 points/yuan**; real payment + server credit; optionally unify recharge → points (drop separate `balanceYuan` or auto-convert).

---

## 9. Word Count Deduction Logic

### Backend — `count_words()` `main.py` L66–71

```python
return len(re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9]+|[\u4e00-\u9fff]", text))
```

Mixed: **each Chinese char + each English/digit token = 1**.

### Frontend — `textStats.ts`

| Function | Lines | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `countBackendWords()` | 18–22 | **Billing** — mirrors backend regex |
| `countThesisWords()` | 2–12 | **Display only** — CN chars + EN words split by whitespace |
| `pointsForTaskSubmission()` | 25–27 | Wrapper around `countBackendWords` |

Used for billing in `GooeySplitButton` (input text). `PolishWorkbenchPage` uses `countBackendWords` for display word counts on output (L411, L472) but **does not bill on output**.

**PM doc requirement:** **1 point = 1 Chinese character only**, deduct on **output**.

**Changes needed:**

- New counter, e.g. `countChineseChars(text)` = `len(re.findall(r'[\u4e00-\u9fff]', text))` in both `textStats.ts` and `main.py` `count_words()` (or separate billing function).
- Bill polished paragraph length after generation, not raw input at task start.
- Update pricing comments (currently say mixed EN/CN).

---

## 10. UI: "积分" vs "剩余可改写字数"

| Location | Line(s) | Current Label |
|---|---|---|
| `AppHeader.tsx` | 192–193 | "积分" + points number |
| `WalletPointsPage.tsx` | 126, 132 | "我的积分" / "当前积分" |
| `UploadCard.tsx` | 220–224 | "预计消耗 … 积分" |
| `taskBilling.ts` | 17 | "…还需 N 积分" |
| `AdminUsersPage.tsx` | 185 | Column "积分" |

**PM doc:** Replace user-facing "积分" with **"剩余可改写字数"** (points = chars conceptually). Admin can keep "积分" internally if desired.

---

## Summary: PM Doc Gap Matrix

| Requirement | Current | Files to Change |
|---|---|---|
| 1 pt = 1 **Chinese char**, deduct on **output** | Mixed EN/CN regex; deduct on **input** at task create; client-only | `textStats.ts`, `main.py` `count_words`, `GooeySplitButton.tsx`, `PolishWorkbenchPage.tsx`, new backend deduct |
| Register **5000** pts | **0** pts | `auth_repo.py` L31, optionally `create_user` callers |
| Daily **1000** free, cap **3000**, midnight refresh | **None** (sign-in 10–30 only) | New model + API + billing order |
| Ad **1000** pts, 5/10/unlimited per day | **450**, no daily cap | `pricing.py`, `pricing.ts`, `ad_watch_repo` + rate limit |
| Recharge 1元=**3000**, pkgs 9.9/19.9/39.9/99 | 1元=**1200**; tiers 9.9/49.9/99; local only | `pricing.py/ts`, `WalletRechargePage.tsx`, payment backend |
| Member **39/100k**, **99/500k** monthly gift pts | 6-tier **word quota** (localStorage demo) | Remove `MembershipContext` quota model; `DashboardPage.tsx`, `pricing.py/ts`, subscription backend |
| UI "剩余可改写字数" | "积分" everywhere | `AppHeader.tsx`, `WalletPointsPage.tsx`, `UploadCard.tsx`, `taskBilling.ts` |

### Architectural debt to flag for PM

1. **Dual billing systems:** Server `PointState` vs client `MembershipContext` word quota vs unused server `UserQuota`.
2. **No server-side task billing** — deductions are not durable.
3. **Two ad paths:** Backend ticket API (`/api/ad/watch-tickets`) vs frontend AdHub QR — not integrated with points sync on Wallet page.
4. **Registration gives 120k admin quota** (`UserQuota`) that frontend membership ignores entirely.

If you want this implemented, switch to Agent mode and I can apply the changes systematically.
